# javaabu/form-builder

> Dynamic forms for Laravel. Forms and entries live in the database, versioned so entries keep the version they were filled with. Forms are defined in a builder (Route::formBuilder(), Blade or Inertia React), fluently in seeders (FormBuilder::define()->…->sync()), from JSON imports or by an optional laravel/ai assistant. A stored version compiles to a javaabu/stencil form (EntryForm): rendering, validation and conditions come from stencil. Sections, wizards, repeating groups, conditions, cascading selects, 17 field types and custom input types. Entries are queryable (whereAnswer), shown read-only and printable, and export to CSV. Permissions through javaabu/permissions. Optional javaabu/translatable. English and Dhivehi, RTL.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/form-builder/.

## Rules

- Define code-owned forms with `FormBuilder::define('key')->name(...)->sections([Section::make('key')->title(...)->fields([Field::text('key')->label(...)->required(), ...])])->sync()` in a seeder. `sync()` is idempotent: it makes a new version only when the structure changes. Use `->locked()` for forms only code may change, and `config('form-builder.builder')` false for no builder at all.
- Never change a published version (`FormVersion`, its sections or fields): it throws. Change a form through its draft (`$form->draft()`, the builder, an import, `sync()`), then `$form->publish()`.
- Field keys are lowercase snake_case, unique in the form (unique within a repeating group for its fields). Answers are stored under them. Don't rename keys of forms that have entries.
- Text (names, labels, help, options, messages) is a string or a locale map `['en' => ..., 'dv' => ...]`. Read it with `Text::resolve()`, never by indexing the map.
- Fill a form with `FormBuilder::fill('key')` (an EntryForm, a stencil form): `{{ $form }}` in Blade, or an Inertia prop rendered by `<StencilForm schema={form} components={formBuilderComponents} />`. Always pass `formBuilderComponents` (or register them with `StencilProvider`), or repeating groups and headings won't render.
- Store submissions with `FormBuilder::submit($form, $request, submitter: $user, subject: $model)`, not by saving `FormEntry` yourself: it validates with the version, normalizes answers and indexes them for `whereAnswer()`.
- Read answers with `$entry->answer('path')` / `$entry->formatted('path')` and show entries with `FormBuilder::display($entry)`. Query with `FormEntry::whereAnswer('field', '>=', 18)` and `group.key` for fields in repeating groups.
- Conditions are declarative (`visibleWhen`, `hiddenWhen`, `visibleWhenChecked`, `hiddenWhenChecked`) and checked in the browser and on the server. Inside a repeating group, conditions watch fields of the same row by key.
- Cascading selects: `Field::select('island')->dependsOn('atoll')->options([['value' => ..., 'label' => ..., 'parent' => ...]])`. The fill and builder routes serve the options; the server checks the pair.
- Add field types by extending `InputTypes\InputType` (key, name, make() returning a stencil component named `$context->name($field->getKey())`, settings, settingsRules, storage, format) and `FormBuilder::registerInputType()`. Custom React inputs use @javaabu/forms' splitFieldProps/useField/useFieldValue/useFieldState/usePublishField and are registered with `StencilProvider`.
- Register routes yourself: `Route::formBuilder(['guard' => ..., 'prefix' => ..., 'name' => ...])` and `Route::formBuilderFill([...])`. Give roles the form permissions, then run `php artisan permissions:sync`. Override with controller subclasses (`config('form-builder.controllers')`) and policies (`config('form-builder.policies')`, `Gate::policy()`), not copied routes.
- Validate definitions (imports, generated JSON) with `DefinitionValidator` or `Importer::read()` before storing them.
- Pass every user-facing string through `__()` and add it to `lang/dv.json`. Use `thaana()` on Dhivehi free-text fields.
